description: Unit test class for the OpenConnectionResponse class in the connectivity command response package. It tests JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, immutability, and resource path retrieval.

classes.name: OpenConnectionResponseTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for verifying functionality of the OpenConnectionResponse class, including JSON serialization, equality, immutability, and resource path methods.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the OpenConnectionResponse class implements equals and hashCode correctly using the EqualsVerifier library.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that instances of OpenConnectionResponse and ConnectionId are immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Tests that creating an OpenConnectionResponse instance with a null ConnectionId throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that deserializing JSON returns an OpenConnectionResponse instance matching expected values.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
